invariants.rationale: Method always constructs and returns a new AvroReaderContextFactory, so result is never null.
Method returns a new AvroReaderContextFactory instance, so result is always of this type.
The method requires a HoodieTableMetaClient to construct the return value, so metaClient is never null at exit.
The AvroReaderContextFactory is constructed with metaClient, so its internal metaClient reference should be equal to the metaClient parameter.
